$comment: Generated by scripts/conformance/build.ts: the test channel, in posting order. A test bot sends each widget as a layer-233 message (inputMediaWidget: html = the file, width / height = the anchors, 0 = auto) with its caption, then the photos (the reference pictures, light then dark) as a separate message next to it. Bots post only into private chats; the shared channel is filled by forwarding.

posts.caption: visual/01-boxes · Boxes: borders, radius, shadows, outline, opacity, overflow clipping. Each box should look like the reference picture posted next to this message.

visual/02-colours-gradients · Colours and gradients: linear, radial, conic; named, hex, rgb() and hsl() colours; colour functions out (hwb, lab, oklch, color(), color-mix); background images. Each box should look like the reference picture posted next to this message.

visual/03-text-a · Text (1/2): system font families, weights, decoration, alignment. Fonts differ between platforms: compare the structure (which line is bold, where text breaks, what is underlined), not the exact letter shapes.

visual/03-text-b · Text (2/2): ellipsis, RTL and Arabic shaping, emoji; line clamp and text-shadow out. Fonts differ between platforms: compare the structure (which line is bold, where text breaks, what is underlined), not the exact letter shapes.
visual/04-layout · Layout: flex with gap, grid, table, positioning and z-index, float; multi-column out. Each box should look like the reference picture posted next to this message.

visual/05-transforms-effects-a · Transforms and effects (1/2): 2D transforms; 3D transforms out (must look flat); filter blur, brightness, drop-shadow. Each box should look like the reference picture posted next to this message. The 3D row must look flat.

visual/05-transforms-effects-b · Transforms and effects (2/2): backdrop-filter blur/brightness; other filters, blend modes, clip-path and mask out. Each box should look like the reference picture posted next to this message.

visual/06-css-animations · CSS animations and transitions, live: slide, spin, pulse, steps, a frozen frame, a transition on tap. Moving rows: the box should move as the caption says (the picture shows the frames it moves between). Frozen row: must match exactly. Tap the last box once.

visual/07-web-animations · Web Animations (element.animate, pause and seek, keyframe offsets, control of CSS animations). Top row moves; the other rows are frozen by script and must match the picture exactly. Tap the bouncing ball to stop it half-way.
visual/08-canvas-a · Canvas 2D (1/2): shapes and paths, line styles, colours, gradients and patterns, text, alpha. Each canvas should look like the reference picture posted next to this message.
visual/08-canvas-b · Canvas 2D (2/2): transforms and clipping; shadows, ctx.filter and conic gradients out; a chart. Each canvas should look like the reference picture posted next to this message.
visual/09-svg-a · Inline SVG (1/2): shapes, structure and viewBox, gradients, text. Each picture should look like the reference picture posted next to this message.
visual/09-svg-b · Inline SVG (2/2): CSS on SVG; clipPath/mask, filters and SMIL out. Each picture should look like the reference picture posted next to this message. Nothing moves: SMIL is out.

visual/10-images · Images: data: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP; object-fit; background images; SVG images, BMP/ICO and remote URLs out (placeholder). Each row should look like the reference picture posted next to this message.
visual/11-interaction · Taps, pressed state, details, drag, hover (desktop), link opening with confirmation. Do what each row says; the widget shows ✓ when it saw the input.

visual/12-theme · Theme: light-dark(), prefers-color-scheme and onTheme follow the chat theme live; the --tg-theme-* palette. Switch the chat between light and dark: the live box must match the picture for the current theme.

visual/13-out-of-profile · Out of the profile, neutralised the same way everywhere: form controls, inner scrolling, sticky, named fonts, 3D, popover over the chat. Each box must look like the reference picture: the out-of-profile feature is simply not there. Tap “Show popover”: nothing may appear outside this bubble.

visual/14-unstyled-document · Unstyled document: the renderer's defaults for the root and the text (no CSS at all). Compare with the picture for the chat's theme: the bubble's own colour behind the text, the chat's text size, the same spacing, a table with row lines, the button in the client's style. Change the chat text size: the text follows.

visual/15-body-background · A body background without a margin reset fills the whole bubble (root background propagation). The whole bubble is dark blue, edge to edge: no strip of the bubble's own colour around the text, in either theme.

visual/16-selection · Text selection: nothing is selectable by default; user-select: text makes a paragraph selectable, its children included. Select text the way your client selects message text (on a phone through the bubble's menu, with a mouse by dragging): only the blue-bordered paragraph can be selected, the bold word in it too, and copying gives its text.

visual/sdk/01-link-external · openLink: the confirmation shows the full URL. Tap each button. Each time the client asks first and shows the whole URL (path, query; the IDN host in its xn-- form), then opens the browser. The client must: A native confirmation with the full URL and Open / Cancel; Open goes to the browser (or the in-app browser, as the client usually does).

visual/sdk/02-link-telegram · openTelegramLink: t.me links open inside the client. Tap each button: the link opens inside Telegram (a channel, a post, a user), never in a browser. The client must: The client's own t.me handling, with its usual confirmations; no external browser.

visual/sdk/03-link-rejected · Invalid links and links over 256 characters are rejected. Tap Try all: no dialog may appear for the bad links; then tap the 256-character link: that one asks. The client must: No dialog for a non-https URL, user info, javascript:, tg:, a t.me URL through openLink or a 257-character URL (the widget gets a TypeError); a dialog for the 256-character one.

visual/sdk/04-link-timer · Links need a press: a timer cannot open one, one press opens one link. Tap the first button and wait 2 s: nothing opens. Tap the second: exactly one dialog, not two. The client must: No dialog from the timer (the host drops it as activation-blocked); one dialog for the two calls of one press.

visual/sdk/05-haptics · Haptics: every impact style, notification type and selection. On a phone tap each button: each one is felt, and they feel different. Desktop and web: nothing happens, no error. The client must: impact light/medium/heavy/rigid/soft, notification error/success/warning, selection played with the platform's generators; nothing on desktop and web.

visual/sdk/06-haptics-rate · Haptics rate limit: a burst of 5, then 10 per second. On a phone: Burst asks for 20 at once, you feel 5. Stream asks for 100 over 2 s, you feel about 25. Hidden: tap, scroll the bubble away within a second, nothing is felt. The client must: A bucket of 5 refilled at 10 per second; the rest dropped silently; nothing from a hidden widget.

visual/sdk/07-storage-recreate · Storage survives the widget being dropped and re-created. Tap +1 three times. Scroll far up the chat until the bubble is rebuilt (Started goes up), scroll back: both counters are still 3. The client must: localStorage and sessionStorage come back with the re-created widget (the client passes its copy at creation).

visual/sdk/08-storage-restart · localStorage survives an app restart, sessionStorage does not. Tap +1 twice. Quit the app completely and open this chat again: local is still 2, session is 0. The client must: localStorage is on disk per (account, chat, message); sessionStorage is in memory until the app restarts.

visual/sdk/09-storage-delete · Storage is deleted with the message. Tap Fill (about 15 KB). Delete this message: the client's widget-storage debug listing (or its storage stats) no longer has an entry for it. The same after Clear cache. The client must: Both areas are deleted with the message, with the chat or its history, with the account and on Clear cache.

visual/sdk/10-storage-quota · QuotaExceededError at 16 KB. Tap Fill: it writes 1 KB values until the client refuses; the line must say QuotaExceededError at 16 KB, for local and for session. The client must: 16384 bytes of keys and values per area; the refused setItem throws a DOMException named QuotaExceededError and stores nothing.

visual/sdk/11-crash-restart · After 2 crashes in a row the widget stays stopped. Tap Crash: the frame freezes with the Widget stopped badge. Scroll away and back: it starts again (Started 2). Crash again, scroll away and back: it stays stopped with the badge. The client must: The frozen last frame with the localised badge; one rebuild after the first crash; none after the second, until the app restarts or the message gets new HTML.

visual/sdk/12-drag-gestures · Drag inside the widget versus the bubble's gestures. Drag the knob left and right: no swipe-to-reply, the list does not scroll. Swipe left on the grey area: swipe-to-reply. Double tap: the reaction appears. Long press: the bubble menu. The counters stay 0. The client must: The widget claims horizontal drags of the knob (touch-action: none, preventDefault); elsewhere the chat keeps swipe-to-reply and scrolling; double tap and long press stay with the bubble and never reach the widget.

visual/sdk/13-max-height · Taller than the cap: a hard clip. The widget is 3000 px tall. The bubble shows the top 600 px and cuts it: no scrolling inside, no expand or fullscreen button. The last mark you see is the cap. The client must: The bubble's height is the cap, 600 px on every client (the shared v0.1.0 value; maximumHeight / maxHeightDp / the web MAX_HEIGHT); content below is clipped.

visual/sdk/14-theme-palette · Theme palette: themeParams and --tg-theme-* follow the chat live. Each row: the swatch from themeParams and the one from the CSS variable are the same colour and match the chat. Switch the theme or night mode: all rows change at once, the counter goes up. The client must: Every themeParams key as #rrggbb, the same values as --tg-theme-* on the root, updated in one task with themeChanged.

visual/sdk/15-storage-forward · A forwarded copy has its own storage. Tap +1 three times, then forward this message to another chat: the copy shows 0, the original still 3. +1 on the copy does not change the original. The client must: Storage keyed by (account, chat, message id): the destination chat's copy starts empty.

visual/sdk/16-bot-edit · A bot edit: same HTML keeps the widget, new HTML restarts it on the same storage. Tap +1 twice. Ask the bot to edit the message with the same HTML: nothing restarts (Started stays). Ask for the edit with version 2: it shows v2, Started goes up, the count is still 2. The client must: An edit with the same HTML keeps the running widget; with different HTML the widget restarts on the same storage.

visual/sdk/17-size-hint · The bubble takes the bot's size anchors before load, then the content height. The bot sends this widget four times: width 0 + height 0 (the default placeholder, then the content height, 240 px), width 0 + height 300 (a fixed 300 px bubble that stays 300 after load), width 300 + height 0 (a 300 px wide widget, then its content height), and width 300 + height 300 (fixed both). The cached height is used next time the auto bubbles scroll in. The client must: Width 0 = the bubble's width, W = a fixed width clamped to [200, max]; height 0 = auto (placeholder, then the reported 240 clamped to [50, 600], cached per message), H = a fixed clamp(H, 50, 600) that the content does not change.

The bot sends this widget four times: width 0 + height 0 (the default placeholder, then the content height, 240 px), width 0 + height 300 (a fixed 300 px bubble that stays 300 after load), width 300 + height 0 (a 300 px wide widget, then its content height), and width 300 + height 300 (fixed both). The cached height is used next time the auto bubbles scroll in. The client must: Width 0 = the bubble's width, W = a fixed width clamped to [200, max]; height 0 = auto (placeholder, then the reported 240 clamped to [50, 600], cached per message), H = a fixed clamp(H, 50, 600) that the content does not change.

The bot sends this widget four times: width 0 + height 0 (the default placeholder, then the content height, 240 px), width 0 + height 300 (a fixed 300 px bubble that stays 300 after load), width 300 + height 0 (a 300 px wide widget, then its content height), and width 300 + height 300 (fixed both). The cached height is used next time the auto bubbles scroll in. The client must: Width 0 = the bubble's width, W = a fixed width clamped to [200, max]; height 0 = auto (placeholder, then the reported 240 clamped to [50, 600], cached per message), H = a fixed clamp(H, 50, 600) that the content does not change.

The bot sends this widget four times: width 0 + height 0 (the default placeholder, then the content height, 240 px), width 0 + height 300 (a fixed 300 px bubble that stays 300 after load), width 300 + height 0 (a 300 px wide widget, then its content height), and width 300 + height 300 (fixed both). The cached height is used next time the auto bubbles scroll in. The client must: Width 0 = the bubble's width, W = a fixed width clamped to [200, max]; height 0 = auto (placeholder, then the reported 240 clamped to [50, 600], cached per message), H = a fixed clamp(H, 50, 600) that the content does not change.
